title: Ring-hand gestures round 2
desc: Gestures redone after J called 814 subpar and X4 unclear: boards say what each is for, named cameras, hands placed exactly, first person reframed.

takes.name: Cast
takes.facts: for firing a power; wind-up 1-6, arm snaps out 6-10, flare and bolt 10-12, hold to 28, settle by 44

takes.name: Oath
takes.facts: fist to the heart by 8, drives up 18-23 with overshoot, head lifts 40 deg, light column 22-30, down by 60

takes.name: Focus
takes.facts: ring stops exactly on the brow at 12, head bows 20 deg, eyes light, two breaths, release by 52

takes.name: Put the ring on
takes.facts: ring is its own object: left hand slides it onto the right hand 8-16, click at 16, power-up 18-22, stand by 46
